nary_nodes.label: Autonomous AI agents cyberattack on Taiwan government agencies
evidence: Hackers deployed an AI system to carry out sophisticated cyberattacks on Taiwan, officials said, in what experts believe is the first known fully autonomous attack on government agencies.

Over four days in July, the AI agents were able to map 21 government systems, crack 85 government user accounts, and extract 2,500 personnel records, according to Dream, an Israeli AI firm that first discovered the attack.

The investigation found clear indications that the attacks originated overseas and involved a hybrid approach in which hackers combined conventional operations with AI agents such as OpenClaw," Taiwan’s Ministry of Digital Affairs said in a Thursday statement.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event representing a malicious cyber operation against a target.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No existing schema.org event type matches a cyberattack.

nary_nodes.label: Huang says AI has become main player in cybersecurity

evidence: He said it raised the question of whether the world was ready with defensive strategies for AI, including the necessary legal frameworks, technical capabilities and policies. “I believe there are still significant gaps.
